liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **St. Stephen** (2 other sources): Notes say it included a tease of 'The Eleven'; Notes say the song included a tease of 'The Eleven' [2][5]
- **Next Time You See Me** (1 other source): Notes identify this song as a Junior Parker cover [2]

## Setlist highlights

- **Mississippi 1/2 Step**: rare: 4 archived performances [18]
- **Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]
- **Dark Star 2nd verse**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [18]

## The recordings

- **deadco2017-06-01.akg481** (recommended): source not stated; 17 songs; 178 min; rated 4.78/5 by 9 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the recording sounds very good, and the band played with great energy [7]
- **DeadCompany2017-06-01.Deadcompany2017-06-01**: source not stated; 17 songs; 174 min; rated 3.5/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Uploader-style comment says the microphone choice suited the situation and the finished recording came out well; Reviewer says the recording's quality came down to where the microphones were placed [14][16]
- **deadandcompany2017-06-01.dpa4022.flac24**: source not stated; 16 songs; 179 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Taper says all recordings made at this show came out well, each with its own character [17]
- **dc2017-06-01.dc2017-06-01_Telefunken**: source not stated; 8 songs; 76 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [5]

## Around the show

- Reviewer calls the second set especially strong, a standout part of the show [6]
- Uploader found the crowd much better than on the previous night, when drunken hooligans ruined his recording [2]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2017-06-01.akg481**: taped by Jeff Frank; transferred by Jeff Frank; source: AKG 481 > V3 > MT2496 [1]
- **DeadCompany2017-06-01.Deadcompany2017-06-01**: taped by Pat Myers; transferred by Pat Myers Aka Datpat; source: Sanken CMS -10 (M-S Stereo Microphone)>Zoom F-8 [2]
- **deadandcompany2017-06-01.dpa4022.flac24**: taped by John Hermsen; transferred by John Hermsen; source: DPA 4022>Naiant Tinybox>Sony PCM M10 [3]. Also: A DPA 4022 microphone recording in FLAC 24-bit exists, with a source entry added to the database [15]
- **dc2017-06-01.dc2017-06-01_Telefunken**: taped by ToddHodulik; transferred by ToddHodulik; source: Telefunken elam 260's (hypers)>Sonosax>AD2K+>PMD661 24/48 [5]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Jam Buzz: [Listen to Dead and Company Keep on Truckin’ Through Bomb Threat at Hollywood Bowl – 5/31/2017 Full Show AUD](https://jam.buzz/listen-dead-company-keep-truckin-bomb-threat-hollywood-ball-5312017-full-show-aud/) [19]
- Poster by Worthpoint: [Dead And Company HOLLYWOOD BOWL Tour Poster Grateful Dead AJ MASTHAY BOB WEIR | #1898134911](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/dead-company-hollywood-bowl-tour-1898134911) [20]
